author: xhigh4
claim: Reduce any putative solution to a primitive one, split into n=1, n=2, and n>=3, and use parity plus square residues modulo 8 to settle all cases.
evidence: For n>=2 parity forces the first two primitive coordinates even and therefore the third odd; this directly feeds both modular contradictions.

glossary.a: the first positive-integer base in the target equation
glossary.b: the second positive-integer base in the target equation
glossary.c: the positive-integer base on the right side of the target equation
